Project.NAME: singularity-cli
Project.keywords: singularity, singu, cli, task-manager, bun, citty, kubb, openapi, grace
Project.annotation: Bun-based `singu` CLI for the Singularity task manager API with local OpenAPI snapshots, generated SDK surfaces, XDG-first runtime storage, and standalone binary builds.

M-SPEC-SYNC.NAME: SpecSync
M-SPEC-SYNC.purpose: Refresh the local OpenAPI snapshot by extracting `swaggerDoc` from the published Swagger UI bootstrap script.

fn-extractSwaggerDoc.PURPOSE: Extract the embedded OpenAPI document from upstream bootstrap source.

M-CODEGEN-CONFIG.NAME: CodegenConfig
M-CODEGEN-CONFIG.purpose: Describe the Kubb generation pipeline that turns the local snapshot into TypeScript models and fetch clients.

export-default.PURPOSE: Expose the Kubb configuration for local generation commands.

M-CLI-ENTRY.NAME: CliEntryPoint
M-CLI-ENTRY.purpose: Provide the top-level `singu` CLI shell and attach auth, project, task, and block command groups.
M-CLI-ENTRY.depends: M-AUTH-COMMANDS, M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-READ, M-PROJECT-ALIAS-COMMANDS, M-TASK-COMMANDS-READ, M-TASK-WRITE-COMMANDS, M-TASK-ALIAS-COMMANDS, M-BLOCK-COMMAND

M-STORAGE-PATHS.NAME: StoragePaths
M-STORAGE-PATHS.purpose: Resolve `SINGU_HOME` overrides and XDG-first config and cache storage paths.

fn-resolveStoragePaths.PURPOSE: Resolve runtime storage paths for config and cache.

fn-ensureDirectory.PURPOSE: Create runtime storage directories with secure permissions.

M-CONFIG.NAME: ConfigStore
M-CONFIG.purpose: Own local auth config and persisted token storage for the CLI runtime.

fn-resolveConfigPaths.PURPOSE: Return config directory and file paths derived from storage paths.

type-CliConfig.PURPOSE: Describe the shape of local CLI configuration.

M-AUTH-RUNTIME.NAME: AuthRuntime
M-AUTH-RUNTIME.purpose: Resolve env-first auth state, validate tokens, and expose active account context for project commands.

fn-resolveAuthState.PURPOSE: Resolve the effective token source and config metadata.

fn-requireAuthContext.PURPOSE: Return the active token and account fingerprint.

fn-validateToken.PURPOSE: Probe the API to confirm that a token is accepted.

fn-buildAuthHeaders.PURPOSE: Build Authorization headers for API calls.

M-API-CLIENT.NAME: GeneratedApiClient
M-API-CLIENT.purpose: Expose generated Singularity API request helpers and TypeScript models under a stable local path.

export-generatedClients.PURPOSE: Generated request helpers for resource operations.

export-generatedModels.PURPOSE: Generated request and response type surfaces.

M-HTTP-RUNTIME.NAME: HttpRuntime
M-HTTP-RUNTIME.purpose: Wrap generated client calls with auth header injection and normalized API errors.

fn-createAuthorizedClient.PURPOSE: Create a generated-client-compatible auth-aware HTTP wrapper.

M-TIME-UTILS.NAME: TimeInputUtils
M-TIME-UTILS.purpose: Parse duration and scheduling inputs such as `1h`, `90m`, `now`, `today`, `tomorrow`, dates, and datetimes into stable task payload values.

fn-parseDurationMinutes.PURPOSE: Parse a CLI duration string into minutes.

fn-resolveScheduleInput.PURPOSE: Resolve schedule shorthands and ISO values into task payload values.

fn-addMinutes.PURPOSE: Add a number of minutes to a Date.

M-PROJECT-REF-CACHE.NAME: ProjectReferenceCache
M-PROJECT-REF-CACHE.purpose: Persist the most recent project list context as account-scoped SID mappings.

fn-saveProjectListContext.PURPOSE: Persist the latest project list SID context.

fn-loadProjectListContext.PURPOSE: Read cached project SID context for the active account.

fn-resolveProjectSid.PURPOSE: Resolve a numeric SID into a raw project id.

M-PROJECT-ALIAS-STORE.NAME: ProjectAliasStore
M-PROJECT-ALIAS-STORE.purpose: Persist stable named aliases for projects inside config storage.

fn-normalizeProjectAliasName.PURPOSE: Validate and normalize project alias names.

fn-setProjectAlias.PURPOSE: Persist or replace a project alias.

fn-listProjectAliases.PURPOSE: List aliases for the active account.

M-PROJECT-REF-RESOLVER.NAME: ProjectReferenceResolver
M-PROJECT-REF-RESOLVER.purpose: Resolve project references expressed as raw ids, numeric SIDs, or `@alias` strings.

fn-resolveProjectReference.PURPOSE: Resolve a user-facing project reference into a raw project id.

type-ResolvedProjectReference.PURPOSE: Describe the resolved id plus reference metadata.

M-AUTH-COMMANDS.NAME: AuthCommands
M-AUTH-COMMANDS.purpose: Implement the `auth` command group for saving, inspecting, and clearing the active token.

export-authCommand.PURPOSE: Parent auth command group for the CLI.

M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-READ.NAME: ProjectReadCommands
M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-READ.purpose: Implement `project list` and `project get` on top of auth, transport, SID cache, and reference resolution.

export-projectCommand.PURPOSE: Parent project command group for read and alias subcommands.

fn-projectListCommand.PURPOSE: List projects and refresh last-list SID cache.

fn-projectGetCommand.PURPOSE: Fetch a single project from a raw id, SID, or alias.

M-PROJECT-ALIAS-COMMANDS.NAME: ProjectAliasCommands
M-PROJECT-ALIAS-COMMANDS.purpose: Implement `project alias set`, `project alias list`, and `project alias remove`.

fn-projectAliasSetCommand.PURPOSE: Persist an alias from a resolved project reference.

fn-projectAliasListCommand.PURPOSE: List aliases for the active account.

M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-WRITE.NAME: ProjectWriteCommands
M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-WRITE.purpose: Implement future project create, update, and delete commands on top of stabilized project reference resolution.

fn-projectCreateCommand.PURPOSE: Create a new project from CLI flags.

M-TASK-REF-CACHE.NAME: TaskReferenceCache
M-TASK-REF-CACHE.purpose: Persist the most recent task list context as account-scoped SID mappings.

fn-saveTaskListContext.PURPOSE: Persist the latest task list SID context.

fn-loadTaskListContext.PURPOSE: Read cached task SID context for the active account.

fn-resolveTaskSid.PURPOSE: Resolve a numeric SID into a raw task id.

M-TASK-ALIAS-STORE.NAME: TaskAliasStore
M-TASK-ALIAS-STORE.purpose: Persist stable named aliases for tasks inside shared config storage.

fn-normalizeTaskAliasName.PURPOSE: Validate and normalize task alias names.

fn-setTaskAlias.PURPOSE: Persist or replace a task alias.

fn-listTaskAliases.PURPOSE: List aliases for the active account.

M-TASK-REF-RESOLVER.NAME: TaskReferenceResolver
M-TASK-REF-RESOLVER.purpose: Resolve task references expressed as raw ids, numeric SIDs, or `@alias` strings.

fn-resolveTaskReference.PURPOSE: Resolve a user-facing task reference into a raw task id.

type-ResolvedTaskReference.PURPOSE: Describe the resolved id plus reference metadata.

M-TASK-COMMANDS-READ.NAME: TaskReadCommands
M-TASK-COMMANDS-READ.purpose: Implement `task list` and `task get` on top of auth, transport, SID cache, reference resolution, and the default actionable task view.
M-TASK-COMMANDS-READ.depends: M-AUTH-RUNTIME, M-HTTP-RUNTIME, M-API-CLIENT, M-TASK-REF-CACHE, M-TASK-REF-RESOLVER, M-PROJECT-REF-RESOLVER

export-taskCommand.PURPOSE: Parent task command group for read and alias subcommands.

fn-taskListCommand.PURPOSE: List tasks through default, inbox, or raw views, sort actionable tasks by start ascending, and refresh last-list SID cache.

fn-taskGetCommand.PURPOSE: Fetch a single task from a raw id, SID, or alias.

M-TASK-ACTION-COMMANDS.NAME: TaskActionCommands
M-TASK-ACTION-COMMANDS.purpose: Implement `task do` and `task undo` on top of task reference resolution and the generated update endpoint.

fn-taskDoCommand.PURPOSE: Mark a resolved task as done.

fn-createTaskCheckedUpdate.PURPOSE: Create the minimal checked-state update payload.

M-TASK-WRITE-COMMANDS.NAME: TaskWriteCommands
M-TASK-WRITE-COMMANDS.purpose: Implement `task add`, `task edit`, `task move`, `task schedule`, `task unschedule`, and `task rm` on top of reference resolution and parsed CLI time input.
M-TASK-WRITE-COMMANDS.depends: M-AUTH-RUNTIME, M-HTTP-RUNTIME, M-API-CLIENT, M-TASK-REF-RESOLVER, M-PROJECT-REF-RESOLVER, M-TIME-UTILS

fn-taskAddCommand.PURPOSE: Create a task from a title and optional project reference.

fn-taskEditCommand.PURPOSE: Rename a task from a raw id, SID, or alias reference.

fn-taskMoveCommand.PURPOSE: Assign a task to a project or move it back to inbox.

fn-taskScheduleCommand.PURPOSE: Update task start and optional deadline values from CLI-friendly schedule input.

fn-taskUnscheduleCommand.PURPOSE: Clear task scheduling fields and reset time-based scheduling metadata.

fn-taskRemoveCommand.PURPOSE: Delete a task from a raw id, SID, or alias reference.

M-TASK-ALIAS-COMMANDS.NAME: TaskAliasCommands
M-TASK-ALIAS-COMMANDS.purpose: Implement `task alias set`, `task alias list`, and `task alias remove`.

fn-taskAliasSetCommand.PURPOSE: Persist an alias from a resolved task reference.

fn-taskAliasListCommand.PURPOSE: List aliases for the active account.

M-BLOCK-COMMAND.NAME: BlockCommand
M-BLOCK-COMMAND.purpose: Create a scheduled focus block as a new task that starts now and ends after a parsed duration.

export-blockCommand.PURPOSE: Top-level `block` command that creates a scheduled task from a duration and title.

M-SINGULARITY-CLI-SKILL.NAME: SingularityCliSkill
M-SINGULARITY-CLI-SKILL.purpose: Guide agents to operate an installed `singu` CLI for auth, project inspection, task workflows, reference resolution, and focus-block capture in end-user environments.
M-SINGULARITY-CLI-SKILL.depends: M-CLI-ENTRY, M-AUTH-COMMANDS, M-PROJECT-COMMANDS-READ, M-PROJECT-ALIAS-COMMANDS, M-TASK-COMMANDS-READ, M-TASK-WRITE-COMMANDS, M-TASK-ACTION-COMMANDS, M-TASK-ALIAS-COMMANDS, M-BLOCK-COMMAND

section-workflow.PURPOSE: Describe how to verify auth, resolve references, and prefer read-only inspection before mutating state through `singu`.

section-common-flows.PURPOSE: Provide canonical auth, project, task, scheduling, and focus-block command examples.

M-RECURRENCE-RULE.NAME: RecurrenceRule
M-RECURRENCE-RULE.purpose: Pure recurrence rule math: next occurrence dates with strict-future clamping and human-readable descriptions driven by the done counter.

M-RECURRENCE-MARKER.NAME: RecurrenceMarker
M-RECURRENCE-MARKER.purpose: Versioned marker codec storing recurrence rules inside the carrier task externalId so chains travel with the task on the server.

M-RECURRENCE-SYNC.NAME: RecurrenceSync
M-RECURRENCE-SYNC.purpose: Pure classification of marker state across a task listing plus the shared API-driven spawn engine; powers `singu recur sync` and `task do` spawning.

M-RECURRENCE-COMMANDS.NAME: RecurCommands
M-RECURRENCE-COMMANDS.purpose: `singu task recur` and `singu task unrecur` managing externalId markers, plus `singu recur sync` reconciliation with legacy registry migration.

CrossLink.relation: Encodes and decodes rules carried by task externalId.
Uses pure rule math for next occurrence scheduling.
Reconciles chains and migrates the legacy local registry.
Classifies marker state and embeds incremented markers into spawned carriers.
Spawns the next occurrence from the completed carrier marker and catches up chains completed outside the CLI.
